purpose: Controlled retrieval experiment tracing the evolution from single-vector semantic retrieval to ColBERT-style multi-vector late interaction.
notes: The corpus and queries remain fixed across all retrieval stages.
Ground truth is established before retrieval is run.
Stage 2 and Stage 3 use mxbai internal contextual representations as an experimental construction; they are not called ColBERT.
The corpus is intentionally small so Stage 3 and Stage 4 can use transparent exhaustive calculations before scalability mechanisms are introduced.
Q11 and Q12 added as multi-query cases; Q01-Q10 baseline ground truth preserved unchanged. Ground truth remains provisional and may be revised from empirical evidence.

query_ground_truth.query: How many annual leave days can I carry over into next year?
What happens to unused vacation at the end of the year?
Can I take my unused leave into the following year, and what is the limit?
What is the rule for carrying forward five unused days of annual leave?
When does unused leave expire if I have more than the allowed carry-forward?
Can unused balances be moved to next year?
How far in advance should I request vacation?
Does working from home require manager approval?
What should I do if my leave balance looks wrong?
Can a chunk mention carry forward and still be irrelevant to annual leave?
How many annual leave days can I carry forward, and when do I need to submit a request to take leave?
Can I work from home with manager approval, and what security requirement applies while working remotely?
